description: One of the 26 unchanged Chandigarh wards, linking 2006 quota assignment to 2011 outcome; filter is_eligible for the 17 later non-quota wards.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Municipal institution; one ward is the row unit.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Ward identifier on the unchanged 2006 geography.

fields.name: prior_year
fields.description: Prior general-election cohort, including deferred ward 7.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Outcome general election.

fields.name: poll_date_2006
fields.description: Actual prior poll: December 20, 2006, except ward 7 on January 14, 2007.

fields.name: poll_date_2011
fields.description: Actual outcome election date.

fields.name: reserved_woman_2006
fields.description: 1 for women-only reservation; 0 for a seat open to both sexes. Taken from the pre-election notification, checked against results.

fields.name: reserved_caste_2006
fields.description: Seat caste reservation; NONE means no caste reservation, not missing.

fields.name: reserved_raw_2006
fields.description: Original reservation label in the result table, preserved without recoding.

fields.name: reserved_source_page_2006
fields.description: One-based PDF page of the pre-election reservation notification in the corresponding source report.

fields.name: source_path_2006
fields.description: Original report path relative to repository root; all page references for this year refer here.

fields.name: source_sha256_2006
fields.description: SHA-256 of the complete unchanged source report.

fields.name: reserved_woman_2011
fields.description: 1 for women-only reservation; 0 for a seat open to both sexes. Taken from the pre-election notification, checked against results.

fields.name: reserved_caste_2011
fields.description: Seat caste reservation; NONE means no caste reservation, not missing.

fields.name: reserved_raw_2011
fields.description: Original reservation label in the result table, preserved without recoding.

fields.name: reserved_source_page_2011
fields.description: One-based PDF page of the pre-election reservation notification in the corresponding source report.

fields.name: source_path_2011
fields.description: Original report path relative to repository root; all page references for this year refer here.

fields.name: source_sha256_2011
fields.description: SHA-256 of the complete unchanged source report.

fields.name: winner_2011
fields.description: Printed elected-person name, not the prior winner.

fields.name: winner_source_page_2011
fields.description: One-based PDF page of elected-person table.

fields.name: winner_woman_from_honorific_2011
fields.description: 1 from Smt./Ms.; 0 from Sh. in uniquely linked candidate row. No name- or quota-based inference. Null if title is not sex-specific; release requires complete outcomes.

fields.name: winner_honorific_raw_2011
fields.description: Printed candidate honorific; independent of reservation label.

fields.name: winner_candidate_name_raw_2011
fields.description: Full source candidate-name cell, retaining title and parenthetical text.

fields.name: winner_candidate_no_2011
fields.description: One-based extracted candidate position within ward; not printed ballot serial.

fields.name: winner_link_basis_2011
fields.description: Unique normalized name within ward, with reviewed Modgil/Moudgil alias only in ward 22.

fields.name: winner_woman_source_page_2011
fields.description: One-based PDF page of separately printed candidate honorific.

fields.name: is_eligible
fields.description: True for 2011 seats open to both sexes, including SC seats. No restriction on winner sex.

fields.name: exclusion_reason
fields.description: included or reserved_for_women_in_2011.

fields.name: caste_transition
fields.description: Prior-to-current seat caste stratum, e.g. SC_to_NONE. Fixed by census rankings rather than women's lottery.

fields.name: population_2001
fields.description: Total persons from the Deputy Commissioner's 2001 Census ward figures, reproduced in the 2011 report.

fields.name: population_sc_2001
fields.description: Scheduled Caste persons from the same table.

fields.name: population_sc_share_2001
fields.description: SC persons divided by total persons; proportion, not percentage.

fields.name: population_sc_rank_2001
fields.description: Descending SC share rank, using minimum rank for ties. Top five SC in 2006, next five in 2011; wards 4 and 18 tie at rank 15.

fields.name: population_source_page
fields.description: PDF page 25 of the 2011 report, printed page 23.

fields.name: boundary_basis
fields.description: Signed administration letter confirms unchanged 2006 ward geography.

fields.name: boundary_source_page
fields.description: PDF page 15 of the 2011 report, printed page 13.

fields.name: assignment_rule_source_page
fields.description: PDF page 20 of the 2011 report, printed page 18; scanned signed letter read visually, applies the October 27, 2006 method to 2011.
